Syntax: dungeon <command> [argument]
              |
              |The pocket dungeon system lets you enter a private instanced dungeon
              |generated just for your party.  Each dungeon has a randomly selected
              |theme, populated with monsters and loot appropriate to your level.
              |
              |Available commands:
              |
              |  {Ydungeon list{x              List available dungeon themes
              |  {Ydungeon enter [theme]{x     Enter a new pocket dungeon (creates one)
              |  {Ydungeon leave{x             Return to your original location
              |  {Ydungeon status{x            Show information about your current dungeon
              |
              |When entering, all group members are transported together.  A shimmering
              |portal in the first dungeon room will return you to where you came from.
              |
              |Dungeons that are left empty will automatically expire and collapse after
              |a period of time; any remaining characters are sent to the temple.
              |
              |See also: GROUP, QUEST
              |
